summary: A high-level security summit in Tehran brings together Iranian, Saudi, Pakistani, and Turkish officials to discuss de-escalation amid regional tensions. Jordanian Air Force strikes kill five civilians in southern Syria. Israeli forces eliminate Hamas commanders and tunnel operatives in Gaza while Hezbollah reportedly rearms with Iranian funding.
key_points: Tehran hosts security summit with Iranian, Saudi, Pakistani, Turkish leaders focusing on de-escalation and mediation by Pakistan and Qatar. (Source: @Faytuks_Network/8921)
Jordanian Air Force strikes kill five civilians including women and children in Daraa suburbs, Syria, per SANA. (Source: @N12chat/231855)
IDF eliminates four Hamas and Islamic Jihad operatives in Gaza, including a sniper and Nukhba commander, and destroys a sniper post. (Source: @yediotnews25/136809)
Three Palestinian operatives emerge from a tunnel in Khan Younis on the Hamas-side of the Yellow Line; airstrike causes secondary explosions indicating weaponry. (Source: @manniefabian/59435)

Iranian President Pezeshkian travels to Moscow to meet Putin and Qatari Emir; IRGC conducts large-scale exercises and test-launches two ballistic missiles from Lut Desert. (Source: @shin_persian/11574, @shin_persian/11571)
Hezbollah spends three months rearming with tens of millions from Iran: attack drones, explosives, rebuilt command structures per Lebanese sources. (Source: @Faytuks_Network/8925)

Israeli Defence Minister Katz denies pre-election Iran strike plans and leadership rift with IDF Chief Zamir; police prepare missile shelters for election day. (Source: @manniefabian/59428, @yediotnews25/136807)
Iranian MP Naderi advocates nuclear bomb test; claims Friday preachers and Supreme Leader representatives agree; suggests Mojtaba Khamenei's fatwa may differ. (Source: @shin_persian/11573)

sections.executive_summary: A high-level security summit in Tehran brings together Iranian, Saudi, Pakistani, and Turkish officials to discuss de-escalation amid regional tensions. Jordanian Air Force strikes kill five civilians in southern Syria. Israeli forces eliminate Hamas commanders and tunnel operatives in Gaza while Hezbollah reportedly rearms with Iranian funding.

points: A high-level security summit in Tehran includes Iranian SNSC Secretary Maj Gen Mohsen Rezaee, Saudi Defence Minister Khalid bin Salman, Pakistani Army Chief Asim Munir, and Turkish Intelligence Head Ibrahim Kalin; discussions focus on de-escalation and mediation by Pakistan and Qatar. (Source: @Faytuks_Network/8921, @yediotnews25/136797)
Iranian President Masoud Pezeshkian is en route to Moscow for a meeting with Russian President Vladimir Putin and the Qatari Emir tomorrow. (Source: @shin_persian/11574)

An unverified photo shows the test launch of two ballistic missiles from the Lut Desert in Kerman, southeastern Iran; the IRGC Aerospace Force is conducting large-scale exercises across the country. (Source: @shin_persian/11571)
The Navy training center in Sirjan, Kerman Province, was fully evacuated of personnel minutes ago, per a delayed post from FromIran with a 120-second delay. (Source: @shin_persian/11577)

Iranian MP Ahmad Naderi states he has advocated for Iran to build and test an atomic bomb for a decade; claims Friday preachers and Supreme Leader's representatives now agree; suggests Mojtaba Khamenei's fatwa on nuclear weapons will differ from his father's due to changed circumstances. (Source: @shin_persian/11573)

US Air Force tanker numbers hold steady at approximately 193 across Europe and CENTCOM after rapid return of KC-135 and KC-46 tankers from Pease base; some tankers used Bomb Mission Codes, possibly related to a STRATCOM exercise rather than Iran strike preparation. (Source: @shin_persian/11579, @shin_persian/11568)
UKMTO issues Warning 183-26 for maritime security; full product available via linked PDF. (Source: @shin_persian/11575)

IDF eliminates four Hamas and Islamic Jihad operatives in the Gaza Strip, including a sniper planning attacks against Israeli forces and a Hamas Nukhba commander in northern Gaza; also destroys a building used as a sniper position; IDF states terrorists acted to restore military capabilities in systematic ceasefire violation. (Source: @yediotnews25/136809)

Three Palestinian operatives emerge from a tunnel shaft on the western, Hamas-side of the "Yellow Line" in Khan Younis, southern Gaza; targeted by airstrike after identification; secondary explosions indicate presence of weaponry in the tunnel. (Source: @manniefabian/59435)

Two Hamas commanders killed in recent strikes: Mohammed Halawa, intelligence officer, killed Saturday in Gaza City; Ahmed Zahir Fuad Abu-Odeh, engineering officer, killed Thursday; IDF says they advanced attacks against troops and civilians and worked to restore Hamas capabilities in violation of ceasefire. (Source: @shin_persian/11565)
An Israeli C-130 Hercules tactical transport aircraft (serial 738A8D, registration 420, squawk 1336) tracked at 3,525 ft over Palestine on a tactical transport mission. (Source: @redlinkleb/50112)

Defence Minister Israel Katz denies reports of a major confrontation with IDF Chief of Staff Lt. Gen. Eyal Zamir; states Israel had no plans to strike Iran before elections; asserts if Iran attacks, Israel will respond with great force; calls reports of disagreements baseless and false. (Source: @manniefabian/59428)

Israeli police prepare for missile fire scenario on election day: officers at polling stations to direct voters to shelters and lock polling stations; voting may pause 2-3 hours and extend hours in coordination with Central Elections Committee and Home Front Command. (Source: @yediotnews25/136807)
Prime Minister's Office denies CNN report as fake news; unspecified content. (Source: @amitsegal/66172)

IDF eliminates four Hamas and Islamic Jihad operatives in the Gaza Strip, including a sniper and Nukhba commander; destroys sniper post; IDF cites systematic ceasefire violation and restoration of military capabilities. (Source: @yediotnews25/136809)

Three Palestinian operatives emerge from a tunnel in Khan Younis on the Hamas-side of the Yellow Line; airstrike hits shaft and operatives; secondary explosions confirm weaponry in tunnel. (Source: @manniefabian/59435)

Two Hamas commanders killed: Mohammed Halawa (intelligence) in Gaza City Saturday; Ahmed Zahir Fuad Abu-Odeh (engineering) Thursday; IDF says they planned attacks and violated ceasefire. (Source: @shin_persian/11565)
Israeli C-130 Hercules tactical transport tracked over Palestine at 3,525 ft on tactical mission. (Source: @redlinkleb/50112)

Hezbollah has spent three months preparing for a potential new war with Israel, using tens of millions of dollars from Iran to rearm, produce attack drones, acquire explosives, and rebuild its command structures, according to Lebanese security sources speaking to Reuters. (Source: @Faytuks_Network/8925)
Red Alert Lebanon issues a signal scan alert for Beirut southern suburbs (Dahieh); live map referenced. (Source: @redlinkleb/50135)
Explosion of a suspicious object at Deir Kifa junction results in injury. (Source: @redlinkleb/50111)
Artillery shelling reported in Wadi Al Salouqi; live map referenced. (Source: @redlinkleb/50157)
Fire in a vehicle at Hasbaya entrance; no security incident reported. (Source: @redlinkleb/50134)
Power outage in Aba causes tree fire; no security incident. (Source: @redlinkleb/50118)
Syrian official news agency SANA reports five civilians, including women and children, killed in Jordanian Air Force strikes on Daraa suburbs. (Source: @N12chat/231855)

Saudi Defence Minister Khalid bin Salman leads delegation at Tehran security summit alongside Pakistani and Turkish officials; discussions include regional security, de-escalation, diplomatic solutions, and implications of Iran-US-Israel confrontation; Saudi Arabia, Pakistan, and Turkey signed a joint defense agreement in August.
